title: Hatty's Cocoa
description: Do you want chocolate? Because this mod adds alot of chocolate!
body:
Have you ever felt that minecraft did not have enough? Yes, well then good news this mod solves that. From chocolate machines to chocolate armor and of course plenty of tasty snacks. So to summarize this mod has everything your little chocolate filled heart could ever desire and then some.



Thanks to KolGames and Crafterman for helping with some textures!
